Captured 2026-10-24 UTC+08, using a fake OAuth token, isolated HOME, loopback
HTTP CONNECT proxy and locally trusted HTTPS mock. No production account,
external DNS lookup or external connection was used.

The fixture describes the /v1/messages?beta=true inference ClientHello, not
/api/claude_code/settings or /api/claude_code/policy_limits. Those control
requests used a different cipher order and omitted ALPN/status_request/SCT.
The inference hello was 1508 bytes including its TLS record header. Two fresh
connections matched after excluding randoms, session bytes and ephemeral key
bytes. The fixture retains their lengths, group IDs, and all extension data.

Two turns with keep-alive used one inference TLS connection. With the mock
closing the first response, the next turn reconnected with the same fresh
hello shape and no PSK extension; the server reported no session resumption.
The fixture does not establish production acceptance, allowance consumption,
other versions/platforms, or equality of the full TLS stack / HTTP framing.
